reason: A dsh plugin that locally OCRs attached images with Tesseract and converts them to text for text-only model requests, with an optional vision-model passthrough mode.

summaries.zh: 使用本地 Tesseract 将附件图片识别为文本，并在发送给模型前将图片内容转换为文本，支持可选的原图透传模式。
summaries.en: Uses local Tesseract OCR to convert attached images into text before model requests, with an optional mode for passing original images through to vision models.

capabilities: Reads attached image data from the local attachment store
Invokes the local Tesseract OCR command-line tool
Rewrites image content blocks into recognized text in LLM requests
Can optionally forward original image bytes to the model provider when passthrough is enabled
